messages:
maya: Quick question — Prospect (HelionCorp) just flagged SCIM delta latency and RBAC mapping in their questionnaire. Can we confirm default SCIM delta window + any recommended rate-limits? Also asking whether we can map Okta group -> Redwood tenant roles during POC. @sam @alex

sam (eng): For SCIM delta our POC default polling is 60s for delta but we can do webhook push if they want near-real-time. Rate limits: 120 req/min by default, can be raised for Dedicated. For mapping: we support group->role via attributes; need exact claim name. :thumbsup:

alex (solutions): Confirming — we can do group-to-role mapping in the POC. Ask Helion for example payload. Sample mapping I've used:
```
scim.group.members -> app.roles
claim: groups
mapping: [{"groupName":"engineers","role":"editor"}]
```

maya: They also want SAML session length 24h and assertion-based tenant binding (email + domain proof). Is that supported?

julie (acct exec): On pricing, they want a 3-month POC with Dedicated-style SLAs. What minimum commit do we need to quote? Also need security questionnaire answered by EOD Thurs.

sam (eng): SAML: yes 24h sessions OK, assertion binding is OK but domain proofing requires DNS TXT or hosted verification — that's an ops step. For POC we can accept org-wide tenant bind by verified domain email+

nick (sec): I'll take the security questionnaire. Can you drop the doc here @maya? I'll fill sections on KMS, audit logs, and penetration testing. Two asks: need to know if they require HSM-backed keys (we support KMS integrations) and whether they want logs forwarded to their SIEM (we can via syslog/forwarder).

maya: Dropped the questionnaire link: https://drive.internal/helion-sq-2026.pdf

maya: Helion also asked about SCIM filtered sync for nested groups and rate spike behavior during onboarding — they expect ~5000 users, 200 groups.

sam (eng): For 5k users we recommend webhook sync + initial bulk import. Batching and pagination: pageSize 200 recommended. For nested groups we flatten during sync; we can provide mapping rules. On rate spikes we throttle + queue; for Dedicated we can bump throughput for onboarding windows.

alex (solutions): For the POC plan I'll prepare a short playbook: initial import, mapping sample, SAML config steps, test assertion, and rollback steps. Can send by EOD.

julie (acct exec): Pricing note: for a 3-month POC with Dedicated-like perf we usually propose a temporary elevated reserved capacity with a short commit — I'll draft a number but need input from eng on expected tps for 5k users.

sam (eng): Estimate: SCIM onboarding ~50 req/s during bulk import; steady-state delta <5 req/s. Token generation and SAML spikes are small but concurrent sessions could bump latency — we can simulate in our load harness.

maya: Great. Can everyone flag blockers? Helion might want legal redlines around data residency and audit retention.

nick (sec): Data residency: for POC we can host in their preferred region (if it's our cloud region). Audit retention: default 90 days, longer available as add-on. Need to know if they want log redaction rules.

maya: I'll set a call with Helion for 11am PT tomorrow to align. @alex please bring the playbook, @sam bring a runnable scim example, @nick bring the security answers.

alex (solutions): Roger. I'll also include a minimal `scim.json` example and a short script to demo group->role mapping.

sam (eng): I'll attach a small script snippet in the thread:
```
# GET /scim/v2/Groups?startIndex=1&count=200
while more:
  fetch page
  apply mapping
```

maya: Thanks all. Julie — can you confirm commercial redlines before the call so we don't get blocked live? :pray:

julie (acct exec): I'll check legal and update the doc by 5pm. If anything critical, I'll ping.

okta-bot: [okta] Webhook test: 200 OK for HelionCorp (request_id=abc123)

maya: Perfect. Looping @helion-tech soon. End of thread.
